Release 1.6.0: monthly export gives amounts, no contact details

Dana Okafor approved the reworked exportMonth CSV: order, date, customer
name, and items, discount, shipping and total in euros. Email and phone
are left out, and names a spreadsheet would read as a formula are kept
as text.
